name: claude-edit-gains-final-newline
description: The base file has no final newline. A Claude Edit rewrites the FIRST line and the file ends up with a final newline (the tool wrote one). An Edit carries no `after` fingerprint, so the ops alone do not determine the final newline: only the real file shows it, which is why the stage is `align`. What this fixture checks is the ORIGINS: a final newline is not part of any line (the line policy), so the last line `blue` is untouched text and stays base, and only line 1 is e1. The final-newline flag itself is not compared at the `align` stage here; WHY-23, which gets the real file, checks it.
